c2f5733682f2daa34ab40f5f444f0086.title: GCC condemns Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia as Yemen fighting intensifies
c2f5733682f2daa34ab40f5f444f0086.source: Al Jazeera – Breaking News, World News and Video from Al Jazeera
c2f5733682f2daa34ab40f5f444f0086.summary: Gulf ministers urge action against Houthis as fighting displaces more than 233,000 people across Yemen.
c2f5733682f2daa34ab40f5f444f0086.title_zh: 海湾合作委员会谴责胡塞派对沙特阿拉伯的攻击行为，因为也门的战斗日益激烈。
c2f5733682f2daa34ab40f5f444f0086.summary_zh: 海湾国家部长们呼吁采取行动打击胡塞派势力，因为战斗导致也门境内超过233,000人被迫迁移。
